title: Production backend reconciliation and outbox index deployment
summary: The live MED+250 schema reconciles contract 2026-07-18.3 and every reviewed governance effect. Two missing notification-outbox foreign-key indexes were installed through the protected transaction-local DDL override and validated in production.

checks.name: Backend contract reconciliation
checks.detail: The live contract function declares version 2026-07-18.3 with the expected 31-function and 24-table MED+250 boundaries.

checks.name: Description governance deployment
checks.detail: All thirteen governance columns, both mandatory product-description triggers, the immutable review ledger, and the single-product review RPC exist with the intended privileges.

checks.name: Trust and catalogue deployment
checks.detail: The aggregate trust function, approval table, multilingual normalization, extended member-pharmacy profile, and both audited catalogue retirements are present in production.

checks.name: Outbox index deployment
checks.detail: Valid offer-reference and pharmacy-reference indexes now cover both notification-outbox foreign keys, and the production advisor reports zero remaining MED+250 unindexed foreign keys.

checks.name: Source evidence binding
checks.detail: The redacted reconciliation receipt is bound to Git revision 5ef50a296941056bd17e614dff7b35290742f50a and retains no database rows, credentials, or response bodies.
